a.text: Being upfront with you: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to wait for 8 cells means we almost certainly both fail before the generator gets anywhere. So I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. After that I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you, and I'll keep my messages accurate.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry this breaks the deal. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator runs and the reserve refills for you. I won't take anything more.
